text: Academic Research 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术研究插件，适用于 web profile。它注册文献搜索、指定公开研究页面读取和来源状态查询工具，并向系统提示加入证据区分规范。主要能力包括并行查询 Crossref 与 OpenAlex、返回书目标识和证据级别、读取受支持的公开 HTTPS 来源，以及提供文献综述、论文写作、引用核验和审稿回复技能。适合需要整理文献、起草或修改论文并追踪引用依据的研究者。无需 API 密钥或额外账号；查询会发送至公开文献服务。
帮我按主题找中英文研究论文并整理成证据矩阵。
想核对论文里的引用和参考文献是否对应。
需要根据已有证据起草或修改学术论文。
如何把审稿意见整理成逐条回复和修改计划？
Help me find papers on a topic and organize their evidence.
Can you check whether my citations match the bibliography?
Academic Research 的功能「双源文献检索」：通过 research_search 按主题查询 Crossref 与 OpenAlex，返回记录、来源状态、标识符和证据级别；每个来源的结果数量可设定。
Academic Research 的功能「读取指定公开研究页面」：通过 research_fetch 读取用户指定或搜索得到的公开 HTTPS 研究记录，并返回有字符上限且带截断标记的文本。
Academic Research 的功能「来源状态查询」：通过 research_source_status 查看插件提供的匿名公开研究来源、传输方式及凭据要求。
Academic Research 的功能「学术工作流技能」：注册文献综述、学术写作、引用核验和审稿回复四项可复用技能，指导建立证据矩阵、核实引文并逐条规划修订。
Academic Research 会把文献查询词发送给 Crossref 与 OpenAlex；读取功能也会向指定的公开研究页面发起请求。结果区分书目元数据与全文链接，链接本身不代表已阅读论文。

Academic Research adds research tools to DeepSeek Harness. It searches Crossref and OpenAlex, reads public research pages, and reports evidence levels. Four skills support literature review, writing, citation checks, and reviewer responses. No key or account is required.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · `@onpeople/dsh-academic-research`：An independent `dsh-plugin` for DeepSeek Harness and OnPeople. It adds a bilingual, evidence-grounded academic research collaborator without requiring an account or a licensed database connection.

The plugin provides:

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · `@onpeople/dsh-academic-research`：The package contains both the standard `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` metadata and a native DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin. The `.onpeople/industry.json` companion lets OnPeople expose the same package as a selectable industry plugin; the DSH runtime uses `src/index.ts` and `cordis.patch.yml`.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：The package is designed for profile-scoped installation. From a DSH checkout or an installed `dsh` command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @onpeople/dsh-academic-research
```

Until the package is published, install a local checkout instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-academic-research
```

For a GitHub release, publish this directory as its own repository and add the
`dsh-plugin` topic so it can be discovered with the rest of the ecosystem.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：After installation, restart the profile. The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so the profile automatically mounts the plugin row. It is not enabled in unrelated profiles.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Use it：Ask the agent directly, for example:

> Search 2020–2024 English papers on graph neural networks for recommender systems. Build an evidence matrix with title, authors, year, DOI, source URL, and evidence limits.

The plugin's tools are:

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `research_search` | Search Crossref and OpenAlex public metadata. |
| `research_fetch` | Read one allowlisted public HTTPS record or page. |
| `research_source_status` | Describe the public source coverage and limitations. |

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Use it：The search tools are read-only and do not accept credentials. Public metadata, abstracts, and full-text links are reported as different evidence levels; a link is never treated as proof that the full paper was read.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm pack
```

The package intentionally keeps provider calls in the plugin and uses only standard `fetch`; no custom UI is required. A host can compose it with its existing tool presentation, Skills, permissions, approvals, and model settings.

@onpeople/dsh-academic-research README · Compatibility：DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and its plugin APIs may change. This package targets the profile-bundle contract available in the current `master` line and keeps the host-specific metadata declarative so a future manifest change can be handled without changing the research workflow content.
